hints.en: When `["TLSv1.0", "TLSv1.1"]` is offered, the starter code connects with `"TLSv1.1"`.

hints.tr: İzinli sürümleri tercih sırasıyla gez; bulamazsan `"protocol_version"`.
hints.en: Go through the allowed versions in preference order; if none is found, `"protocol_version"`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def pick_version(offered):
    for version in ["TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"]:
        if version in offered:
            return version
    return "protocol_version"

print(pick_version(["TLSv1.2", "TLSv1.3"]))
print(pick_version(["TLSv1.0", "TLSv1.2"]))
print(pick_version(["SSLv3", "TLSv1.0", "TLSv1.1"]))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def pick_version(offered):
    for version in ["TLSv1.3", "TLSv1.2"]:
        if version in offered:
            return version
    return "protocol_version"

print(pick_version(["TLSv1.2", "TLSv1.3"]))
print(pick_version(["TLSv1.0", "TLSv1.2"]))
print(pick_version(["SSLv3", "TLSv1.0", "TLSv1.1"]))
```
